title: FATHER GOD, RELEASE ANGELIC PROTECTION OVER MY FAMILY
text: Beloved, before we go into the depths of this prophetic prayer, I want you to do something for me. Share this [music] prayer with somebody. Don't just keep it to yourself. There is a family that is under siege right now. There is a household that the enemy has marked for destruction and God has orchestrated that this prayer will be the instrument of their deliverance. So share it with five people. Share it with 10 people. Share it on your timeline. Send it in your family group. The scripture says in Psalm 68-11, the Lord gave the word, great was the company of those that published it. When you publish the word, when you share the prophetic [music] utterance, you become a co- lababorer with the Holy Spirit in the deliverance of families. So, pause right now and share this [music] with someone. It may be the key to their breakthrough. Now, lift up your hands wherever you are. I don't care if you're in your bedroom, in your car, in your office. Lift up those hands. We are about to invoke the presence of the almighty. We are about to summon the angelic host of heaven. And I want you to understand that the realm of the spirit is more real than the realm of the physical. What you are [music] about to experience is not just a prayer. It is a prophetic transaction. It is a divine encounter. It is an invasion of heaven into your circumstances. [music] Father, we come before you in the matchless name of Jesus Christ. We acknowledge that you are Jehovah Sabbath, the Lord of hosts, the commander of the armies of heaven. We recognize that you are El Shadai, the God who is more than enough. We worship you as Jehovah Shama, the God who is present. And even now as we gather in your name, we know that you are here. Your word declares in Matthew 18:20 that where two or three are gathered in your name, there you are in the midst. So we acknowledge your presence. We welcome you into this moment. We invite the Holy Spirit to take absolute control. Let every distraction be silenced in the name of Jesus. Let every wandering thought be arrested. Let every competing voice be muted. And let the voice of God alone speak into our spirits. Now I want you to understand something about angelic protection. This is not a topic of mythology. This is not the stuff of fairy tales. This is biblical reality. The scripture is replete with [music] instances where God deployed his angels for the protection of his people. In 2 Kings chapter 6, when the prophet Elisha was surrounded by the Syrian army, his servant was afraid. But Elisha prayed and said, "Lord, open his eyes that he may see." And when his eyes were opened, he saw that the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha. The angels of God were there in military formation ready to defend the prophet. In Daniel chapter 6, when Daniel was thrown into the lion's den, God sent his angel to shut the mouth of the lions. In the book of Acts 12, when Peter was in prison, bound with chains and guarded by 16 soldiers, an angel of the Lord appeared, the chains fell off, the prison doors opened, and Peter walked out. In Psalm 34:7, the Bible says, "The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him, and deliverth them." In Psalm 91-11, the scripture declares, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways." So when we pray for angelic protection, we are not praying something that is outside the will of God. We are praying within the framework of divine revelation. We're invoking what God has already promised. And I declare over your life right now, the same God who sent angels to protect Elisha, the same God who sent [music] angels to deliver Peter, the same God who sent angels to shut the mouths of lions, that same God is about to deploy his angelic host for the protection of your family. Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray for every family that is hearing this prayer. I speak to the four corners of their homes right now. I decree and declare that the angel of the Lord is taking his position at the north, at the south, at the east, and at the west. I declare that your home is surrounded by the angelic host of heaven. Every satanic surveillance over your family is dismantled right now in the name of Jesus. Every demonic monitoring system that has been tracking the movements of your children, I [music] command it to be destroyed by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Every witchcraft altar where your family name has been mentioned, I decree that altar is overturned right now in the mighty name of Jesus. The Bible says in Exodus 23:20, behold, I send an angel before thee to keep thee in the way and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared. God is not just sending angels to protect you where you are. He's sending angels to guide you to where you need to be. There is a prepared place for your family. There is a wealthy place. There is a place of honor. There is a place of divine favor. And the angels of God are escorting [music] you there. Every spirit that is sent to divert you, to distract you, to derail you from your divine destination, I command that spirit to be paralyzed right now in the name of Jesus Christ. I want you to understand the ministry of angels. Angels are not decorations. They are not symbols. They are ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation. That's what Hebrews [music] 1:14 says. Angels are servants of God assigned to assist believers. They carry out divine assignments. They execute the word of God. Psalm 103 to 20 says, "Bless the Lord, ye his angels that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word." Angels hearken to the voice of God's word. So when you declare the word of God, when you prophesy [music] the word of God over your family, you are giving angels an assignment. You are releasing them to walk on your behalf. So open your mouth right now and begin to declare the word of [music] God over your family. Say, "My family is covered by the blood of Jesus. My children are protected by divine angels. My home is a sanctuary of the most high God. No weapon formed against my household shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against my family in judgment is condemned. I am surrounded by the favor of God as with a shield. My going out and my coming in [music] is blessed. The Lord preserves my family from all evil. He preserves our souls. The Lord watches over us from this time forth and even forever more. Father, I decree angelic protection over every child, over every spouse, over every parent that is represented in this prayer. I declare that they shall not be victims of accidents. They shall not be victims of sudden attacks. They shall not fall into the traps of the enemy. The scripture says in Psalm 91:3, "Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler and from the noisome pestilence. Every snare that has been set for your children, I command those snares to [music] catch the hunters in the name of Jesus. Every trap that has been laid for your family, I decree that those who laid the trap shall fall into it themselves. The Bible says in Psalm 7:15, he made a pit and digged it and is falling into the ditch which he made. I prophesy that every enemy of your family shall fall into the pits they have dug for you. Now I need you to understand that there are different kinds of demonic attacks against families. There are attacks against the peace of the home. There are attacks against the unity [music] of the family. There are attacks against the finances. There are attacks against the health. There are attacks against the children. There are attacks against marriages. And the devil is strategic. The Bible says he is the thief who comes to steal, to kill, and to destroy. But Jesus said, "I am come that they might [music] have life and that they might have it more abundantly." So we are not just praying for protection from physical harm. We are praying for protection from every form of satanic [music] infiltration. We are praying that the peace of God which surpasses all understanding will guard the hearts and minds of everyone in your family through Christ Jesus. We are praying that the love of God will be shed abroad in your hearts by the Holy Ghost. We are praying that the spirit of unity will prevail. We are praying that divine health will be the portion of every member of your household. We are praying that financial breakthroughs will locate you. We are praying that academic excellence will be the testimony of your children. We are praying that professional advancement will be your story. Father, I take authority over every spirit of strife in families. Every spirit of division, every spirit of misunderstanding, [music] every spirit of bitterness, every spirit of unforgiveness, I command you to lose your hold and come out in the name of Jesus. I decree that the love of God is being poured into hearts right now. I decree that husbands and wives are being reconnected by [music] divine love. I decree that parents and children are being reconciled by the spirit of God. I decree that siblings are being united by the bond of peace. Every household that has been fragmented by the devices of the devil, I decree divine restoration right now in the mighty name of Jesus. I pray for the children. Lord, your word says in Isaiah 54-13, "And all thy children shall be taught of the Lord, and great shall [music] be the peace of thy children. I decree that every child is being taught by the Lord. I decree that they are covered with divine wisdom. I decree that they are protected from evil companionship. I decree that they are shielded from the corruption of this generation. Every child that is being influenced by wrong associations, I command that influence to be broken right now in the name of Jesus. I decree that they shall be like Daniel, like Joseph, like Esther, set apart for divine purposes, walking in uncommon favor, exhibiting supernatural wisdom. Father, I pray for angelic protection over the movements of families. As they go out and as they come in, let your angels go before them and behind them. The Bible says in Isaiah 52:12, "For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight, for the Lord will go before you, and the God of Israel will be your reward." I decree that God goes before you and behind you. I decree that you are sandwiched by divine protection. Every ambush on the road, I command it to scatter in the name of Jesus. Every plan of the enemy for road accidents, for attacks, for hijacking, for kidnapping, I decree that those plans are frustrated right now in the mighty name of [music] Jesus. I speak to every vehicle, every car, every [music] motorcycle, every bicycle, every means of transportation. I decree that they are covered by the blood of Jesus. I decree that angels are stationed in those vehicles. I decree that as [music] your family travels, they travel with divine escort. The scripture says in Psalm 121 to8, "The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth [music] and even forever more. I release this word over your family. Your going out is blessed. Your coming in is blessed. Your movements are secure. Your journeys are divinely orchestrated." Now, I want to deal with something very specific. There are demonic arrows that are fired at families. The Bible talks about it in Psalm 91:5. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flyth [music] by day. There are arrows that fly in the night season. There are arrows that fly in the day. These are not physical arrows. These are spiritual arrows. They are curses. They are enchantments. They are evil pronouncements. They are witchcraft projections. They are evil dreams. They are satanic manipulations. So right now, I take authority over every [music] arrow that has been fired at your family. Every arrow of sickness, I command you to go back to your sender in the name of Jesus. Every arrow of untimely death, I command you to return to where you came from. Every arrow of poverty, backfire in the name of Jesus. Every arrow of confusion, backfire. Every arrow of marital problems, backfire. Every arrow of failure, backfire. Every arrow of disappointment backfire. Every arrow of shame backfire. I decree that every arrow fired at your family is being returned to the sender sevenfold in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Father, your word says in Isaiah 54-17. No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn. I decree that no weapon formed against this family shall prosper. Every weapon of gossip, every weapon of slander, every weapon of false accusation, every weapon of witchcraft, [music] every weapon of sorcery, every weapon of manipulation, I decree that those weapons are rendered powerless right now in the name of Jesus. And every tongue that rises in judgment, every [music] evil pronouncement, every curse, every hex, every spell, I condemn it right now. I decree that it shall not stand. It shall not come to pass. It is null and void in the mighty name of Jesus. I pray for angelic visitation in dreams. The Bible is full of instances where angels visited people in dreams to give them instruction, to give them warnings, to give them direction. In Matthew chapter 2, an angel appeared to Joseph in a dream and warned him to flee to Egypt because Herod was seeking to kill the child Jesus. That angelic warning saved the life of the Messiah. I pray that angels will visit your family in dreams. I pray that [music] they will give you warnings about impending danger. I pray that they will give you instructions about steps to take. I pray that they will give you revelations about the plans of the enemy so that you can pray and frustrate those plans. Father, I ask that you release the spirit of discernment upon [music] families. Let them be able to discern the times and the seasons. Let them be able to discern the presence of evil. Let them be able to discern the devices of the devil. Your word says in 2 Corinthians 2:11, "Lest Satan should get an advantage of us, for we are not ignorant of his devices." I pray that families will not be ignorant of the devil's devices. I pray that they will be spiritually alert, spiritually sensitive, spiritually aware. I decree that they shall see through the schemes of the enemy and they shall counter those [music] schemes with the word of God and with prayer. I want you to begin to thank God right now. Begin to thank him for angelic protection. Begin to thank him for divine covering. Begin to thank him for his faithfulness. The Bible says in Psalm 10:4, "Enter into his gates with thanksgiving and into his courts with praise. Be thankful unto him and bless his name." As you thank God, you are opening the gates for more blessings to flow. As you praise him, you are inviting his presence. [music] As you worship him, you are creating an atmosphere where demons cannot operate. So lift up your voice and say, "Thank you, Jesus, for angelic protection over my family. Thank you for covering us with your blood. Thank you for surrounding us with your favor. Thank you for going before us and behind us. Thank you for making our enemies to be at peace with us. Thank you for confusing the plans of the wicked. Thank you for turning our trials into triumphs. Thank you for turning our tests into testimonies. [music] Thank you for making a way where there seems to be no way. Thank you for being our shield and our exceeding great reward. Father, I pray for every home that is under spiritual attack right now. I decree that the attack is over. I decree that the siege is broken. I decree that the stronghold is demolished. I decree that the chains are falling off. I decree that the prison doors are opening. I decree that freedom is being released. The Bible says in 2 Corinthians 3:17, "Where the spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty." I decree that the spirit of the Lord is invading your home right now. And liberty is being released. Every bondage is being shattered. Every oppression is being lifted. Every burden is being destroyed. Every yoke is being broken by the anointing in the mighty name of Jesus. I speak to homes where there has been constant sickness. I decree divine health. I decree that sickness shall not be a resident in your home. The scripture says in Exodus 15:26, "I am the Lord that health thee. I decree that the Lord who is your healer is visiting your home right now with healing power. Every infirmity be healed in the name of Jesus. Every disease be cured in the name of Jesus. every affliction be destroyed in the name of Jesus. I decree that as the sun rises, healing shall arise with healing in his wings upon your family. I speak to homes where there has been financial [music] struggle. I decree financial breakthrough. I decree that lack shall not be your portion. The scripture says in Philippians 4:19, "But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." I decree that God is opening the windows of heaven over your family. I decree that he is pouring out blessings that you shall not have room enough to receive. I decree that he's rebuking the divorer for your sake. I decree that your finances are being multiplied. I decree that debt is being cancelled. I decree that lack is being abolished. I decree that abundance is your new reality in the mighty name of Jesus. I speak to homes where children have been rebellious, where children have been wewarded. I decree that the [music] spirit of rebellion is broken right now in the name of Jesus. I decree that those children are coming back to their senses. The Bible tells us about the prodigal son who left his father's [music] house and went into a far country and wasted his substance with riotous living. But the Bible says he came to himself. I decree that every prodigal [music] child is coming to himself right now. I decree that they are returning to the father's house. I decree that they are being restored. I decree that they are being reconciled. I decree that the joy of the family is being restored in the mighty name of Jesus [music] Christ. I want you to do something right now. I want you to visualize angels in your home. See them standing at the doors. See them standing at the windows. See them standing over the beds where your children sleep. See them walking through the corridors of your house. The Bible says that angels are innumerable. Hebrews 12 22 talks about an innumerable company of angels. There are more angels than you can count. And God can [music] assign as many as you need for the protection of your family. So begin to declare, "Angels of God, I welcome you into my home. I acknowledge your presence. I recognize your assignment. I submit to the will of God for my family. I cooperate with your [music] ministry. I decree that you are free to move. You are free to act. You are free to execute the word of God on behalf of my family. Thank you for your service. Thank you for your faithfulness. Thank you for being on assignment [music] for my household. Father, I pray for angelic protection in the workplace. Many families are being attacked through their places of work. There are conspiracies in offices. There are plots, there are schemes, there are jealousies, there are envies. But your word says in Romans 8:31, if God be for us, who can be against us? I decree that God is for [music] your family. And because he's for you, no one can successfully stand against you. Every conspiracy [music] in the workplace, I command it to scatter in the name of Jesus. Every plot against your promotion, I decree that it is frustrated. every scheme to terminate your employment. I decree that it backfires on the schemers. I decree that you are working in supernatural favor. I decree that you are excelling beyond your qualifications. [music] I decree that you are being celebrated where you used to be tolerated. I pray for angelic protection in schools. I decree that your children are protected from bullying, from molestation, from evil influences, from cultism, from immorality, from [music] violence. I decree that angels are stationed in their schools. I decree that angels are guiding them, teaching them, protecting them. The Bible says that the angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him. I decree that angels are camping around your children in school. They shall not be victims of any evil. They shall not be casualties of any satanic agenda. They are preserved. They are protected. They are covered by the blood of Jesus. Father, I take authority over every [music] evil dream, every nightmare, every troubling vision that members of this family have experienced. The Bible says in Job 33-15:16, "In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep fallth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed, then he openeth the ears of men and sealeth their instruction." God speaks in dreams, but the enemy also tries to torment people through dreams. So I take authority over every evil dream. I decree that every satanic dream is nullified, every evil vision is canceled, every nightmare is rendered powerless. I decree that from now on families will have godly dreams, prophetic dreams, instructive dreams, encouraging dreams, revelatory dreams. The enemy shall not have access to the dream life of your family in the mighty name of Jesus. I want you to understand something about the blood of Jesus. The blood of Jesus is the most powerful weapon in spiritual warfare. When the children of Israel were in Egypt and the angel of death was about to pass through the land, God instructed them to apply the blood of a lamb on the doorpost of their houses. And the Bible says in Exodus 12:13, [music] "And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are. And when I see the blood, I will pass over you and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you. So right now, I want you to plead the blood of Jesus over your family. [music] Say, I cover my family with the blood of Jesus. I cover my home with the blood [music] of Jesus. I cover my children with the blood of Jesus. I cover my spouse with the blood of Jesus. I cover my parents with the blood of [music] Jesus. I cover every member of my household with the blood of Jesus. Let the blood speak [music] protection. Let the blood speak preservation. Let the blood speak deliverance. Let the blood speak victory. Let the blood speak healing. Let the blood speak prosperity. Let the blood speak peace. Let the blood speak life. Father, I decree that the blood of Jesus is [music] speaking over families right now. The Bible says in Hebrews 12:24 that the blood of Jesus speaks better things than the blood of Abel. Abel's blood cried for vengeance. But Jesus's blood speaks [music] mercy, speaks forgiveness, speaks redemption, speaks [music] protection, speaks victory. So I decree that the blood of Jesus is speaking over your family. It is speaking peace where there has been turmoil. It is speaking [music] health where there has been sickness. It is speaking prosperity where there has been poverty. It is speaking unity where there has been division. It is speaking joy where there has been sorrow. It is speaking victory where there has been defeat. Now I want to pray specifically against some spirits that attack families. There is a spirit called the spirit of Jezebel that seeks to dominate, to manipulate, to control. This spirit seeks to usurp authority in homes to undermine headship to create confusion in roles. I take authority over the spirit of Jezebel. Every jezebelic inference in your home I command it to be uprooted right now in the name of Jesus. [music] Every spirit of manipulation come out. Every spirit of control come out. Every spirit of domination come out. I decree that divine order is being restored in your home. I decree that everyone is fulfilling their God-given role. I decree that there is harmony, there is respect, there is love, there is peace in the mighty name of Jesus. There is a spirit called the spirit of Herod that seeks to kill destinies, especially the destinies of children. This spirit wants to abort purpose, to [music] destroy potential, to cut short what God has ordained. I take authority over the spirit of Herod. Every herodic agenda [music] against your children, I decree that it is frustrated right now in the name of Jesus. Every plan to cut short their lives, I command it to be nullified. Every plan to abort their purpose, I decree that it is canled. Your children shall live and not die. They shall fulfill their destinies. They shall accomplish all that God has ordained for them. They shall excel in their generation. They shall be world changers. They shall be history makers. They shall [music] be destiny fulfillers in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. There is a spirit called the spirit of Abselum that brings rebellion, that brings betrayal, that brings division in families. This spirit causes children to rise against parents, causes siblings [music] to fight against each other, causes relatives to become enemies. I take authority over the [music] spirit of Abselum. Every abselonic spirit in your family, I command you to lose your hold and come out in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of rebellion be bound. Every spirit of betrayal be bound. Every spirit of division be bound. I decree that love is being restored. I decree that loyalty is being established. I decree that unity is being cemented. I decree that your family is coming together in the bond of peace, walking in agreement, walking in harmony, walking [music] in love. I decree that your family is being fortified with the word of God. The Bible says in Joshua 1:8, "This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth, but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein. For then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success. I decree that the word of God is [music] becoming the foundation of your family. I decree that you are meditating on [music] the word day and night. I decree that the word is guiding your decisions. The word is shaping your values. The word is directing your steps. I decree that your family is becoming a family that honors God, that serves God, that worships God, that obeys God. And because you honor him, he shall honor you. Because you serve him, he shall serve your interests. Because you worship him, he shall make you worthy of honor. Father, I pray for a fresh baptism of the Holy Spirit upon families. The Holy Spirit is the comforter, the teacher, the guide, the counselor. I pray that families will be filled with the Holy Spirit, that they will be led by the Holy Spirit, that they will be empowered by the Holy Spirit. I decree that the fruit of the spirit is being manifested [music] in homes. Love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, meekness, [music] temperance. I decree that the gifts of the spirit are being activated. Wisdom, knowledge, faith, healing, [music] miracles, prophecy, discerning of spirits, tongues, interpretation of tongues. I decree that your home is [music] becoming a center of the Holy Spirit's activity. A place where God is glorified. A place where miracles happen. A place where destinies are shaped. I want you to make a declaration right now. Say it with authority. Say it with faith. Say it with conviction. My family is covered by the blood of Jesus. My family is protected by angelic hosts. My family is sealed by the Holy Spirit. My family is surrounded by the favor of God. No weapon formed against my family [music] shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against my family in judgment is condemned. My family walks in divine health. My family walks in financial abundance. My family walks in peace. My family walks in joy. My family walks in victory. My family is blessed going out and blessed coming in. My family is the head and not the tail. My family is above only and not beneath. My family is blessed in the city and blessed in the field. My family is a covenant family, a royal family, a chosen generation, a peculiar people called to show forth the praises of him who called us out of darkness into his marvelous light. Father, I seal this prayer with a prophetic declaration. I decree that from this day forward, angelic protection is activated over every family that has participated in this prayer. I decree that angels are being dispatched right now from the throne of God. They are being sent with specific assignments. Some are sent to protect. Some are sent to provide. Some are sent to guide. Some are sent to heal. Some are sent to deliver. Some are sent to prosper. I decree that these angels are taking their positions right now. They are standing guard over your homes. They are watching over your movements. They are fighting your battles. They are opening doors for you. They are bringing blessings to you. I decree that the next season of your family life is a season of supernatural protection, supernatural provision, supernatural promotion, supernatural peace. The enemy has tried to destroy your family, but God is about to restore your family. The enemy has tried to divide your family, but God is about to unite your family. The enemy has tried to impoverish your family, but God is about to prosper your family. The enemy has tried to bring shame to your family, but God is about to bring honor to your [music] family. I see families being celebrated. I see families being elevated. I see families being established. I see children excelling. I see marriages thriving. I see businesses [music] prospering. I see health being restored. I see debts being cancelled. I see doors being opened. I see breakthroughs manifesting. I see testimonies [music] being shared. This is your season. This is your time. This is your moment. Receive it by faith in the mighty name of Jesus [music] Christ. Amen. And amen.
